_source: NAC's own photographs of NAC's own installations, supplied by Nick on 15 October 2026. Unlike the generated fixtures in tests/, these are real.
_privacy: Checked on arrival: all seven carry a small EXIF block and NONE carries a GPS IFD, so no customer's location is in them. They are re-encoded again on import, which is what strips the remaining metadata off the copy a customer receives — the result is measured and shown on the Images panel rather than assumed.
_models: THE MODEL NUMBERS ARE NOT RECORDED — the compliance plate is not legible in any of these photographs, and a guessed model is a guess on a customer's quote. THE BRAND IS legible in every one: it is the badge on the front. Nick, 16 October 2026: "Just use brands. Put one of the Daikin ones next to a Daikin, Fujitsu next to Fujitsu." So equipmentImagesFor() matches on the brand when no photograph names the model, and an exact model still wins when one is recorded. Filling a model in later only makes the match sharper; it is not needed for these to appear.
_consent: An installation photograph also needs a suburb and consent before it reaches the gallery. Those are NAC's to record; nothing here assumes them.
_orientation: Every one of these is PORTRAIT. The cover wants one wide landscape shot of a finished install, at least 1600 px across, and none of these is it.

photos.alt: A Zonemaster six-zone wall panel, with a labelled switch for each zone
photos.seen: A white wall plate badged Zonemaster at the bottom right, carrying six labelled buttons in a column with a round illuminated switch beside each. The labels read FAMILY, LOUNGE, MASTER, BEDROOM 2, BEDROOM 3 and STUDY. Five of the rings are lit blue; the one beside BEDROOM 2 is pale, so that zone is off.
photos._provenance: Supplied by Nick on 5 November 2026. A product image of a Zonemaster wall panel. Cropped only: the image was cropped to the panel itself (the supplied file was 527x527 with the panel occupying a 247x376 box) and then centred on white in a 600x600 square, which is the shape the page renders it in. Nothing in it was retouched. WHAT IT IS OF, ON NICK'S WORD: this is the wall plate that ships with NAC's Siemens zone kits (MMASEM4ZTPKIT / MMASEM6ZTPKIT / MMASEM8ZTPKIT). Nick, 5 November 2026: 'Just put it in the pic for siemens.' Nothing in the data could have established that — the kit is badged Siemens and the plate is badged Zonemaster — so the pairing is recorded against the part in designer/engines/supplier-pricing.mjs, not inferred by any matcher. NOTE the panel in this photograph has SIX buttons, so it is exact for the 6-zone kit and shows two switches too few on an 8-zone job and two too many on a 4-zone one; a 4-zone and an 8-zone photograph would make it exact.

_brands: Fujitsu x2, Daikin x3, Braemar x2, AirTouch x2. The Braemar pair arrived 16 October 2026, after a Braemar quote had been rendering the plain branded card for want of one. The close shot is listed first, so it is the one that reaches the system card: a customer looking at 'your recommended system' wants the machine, not the plant deck.
_controllers: The two AirTouch consoles and the Fujitsu wall controller are tagged 'controller'. A controller is part of the system but it is not a picture OF the system, so where a brand offers both, the unit goes on the card first.
